# Giridhar Dhatric

> Staff Software Engineer — Cloud-Native, Event-Driven Distributed Systems (Java, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, Kafka).
> Hyderabad, India. Multi-tenant service extensibility platform on Flowable: Java SDK + secure sandbox, 20+ teams, 1,000 workflow executions/sec (100ms p95).

## Key topics

- Cloud-native platforms and multi-tenant SaaS (service extensibility, Java SDK)
- Distributed systems and event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
- Workflow orchestration (Flowable Enterprise / BPMN, Camunda/Temporal evaluation)
- Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL, gRPC, Python and backend engineering
- Azure, Kubernetes, Docker
- Observability (OpenTelemetry, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana) + PostgreSQL tuning (PgBouncer, HikariCP)

## Experience

- Staff Software Engineer at Blue Yonder (Mar 2021 – Present): led team of 8 building a Flowable-based multi-tenant service extensibility platform (Java SDK, gRPC Groovy sandbox) for 20+ teams; 1,000 exec/sec at 100ms p95.
- Senior Software Engineer at Deloitte (Feb 2015 – Mar 2021): ExxonMobil B2B portal — ML-driven stock replenishment (-20% shortages), Spring Boot + RabbitMQ subscriptions (+15% recurring), buy-back/marine ordering.
- Software Engineer at Infosys (Oct 2011 – Jan 2015): Singtel B2C mobile/SIM retail on SAP Commerce (Hybris) — cart restoration, Solr-indexed search.
